title: 便利商店
summary: Open all night, and you can do almost anything there.
paragraphs: 在臺灣，到處都有便利商店。
便利商店二十四小時都開，非常方便。
你可以在那裡買飯糰、咖啡和報紙，也可以繳電話費、寄包裹。
晚上肚子餓的時候，我常常去便利商店買一碗泡麵。
店員都很親切，看到客人會說：「歡迎光臨！」
translation: In Taiwan there are convenience stores everywhere.
They are open twenty-four hours, which is very convenient.
You can buy rice balls, coffee and newspapers there, and also pay your phone bill or send a parcel.
When I get hungry at night I often go buy a bowl of instant noodles.
The clerks are friendly. When they see a customer they say, "Welcome!"
